missing: A checked list of chargers with 200W+ total output whose power-allocation tables actually show two USB-C ports holding 100W each simultaneously (e.g. Anker Prime 250W, Ugreen Nexode 300W, Satechi 200W class), with current prices, plug types and what drops off when a third device is added.
why: No major reviewer or authority tests this exact question. Half the results are empty PDFs or a 404; three are brand pages for 100W-total chargers that mislead by claiming "two laptops at once" while sharing 100W; Digital Camera World is about power banks. Digital Trends mentions one qualifying charger inside a back-to-school roundup, and the itechguides listicle only explains why 140W units fall short. A focused page listing 200W+ chargers with verified dual-100W allocation, prices and codes would be the only direct answer.
